name: Submit Cookies
description: Submit {count} cockies. Should be called bakie instead - get it? Because you bake a cookie instead of cooking it. You see if it were cooked then it would make a lot of sense for it to be called a cookie, but since it is baked then a bakie would make more sense - don't you think? I mean, you could also call it a biscuit but that comes from the latin biscocktus I mean biscocktus I mean biscuctus, which comes from Bis meaning twice, and Cocktus I mean Coctus meaning to cook. But if it is baked? So who is it not called a bakie??? Thank you for cocking I mean coming to my TED Talk, I feel like I cocked I mean cooked here. PS: You can feed these to parrots for a fun advancement BTW!
